name: Garland Style Jewellery
summary: The white jewel of the Edwardian court. It is platinum lace of garlands, bows, laurel and ribbon, set with diamonds and pearls, as light as a thread. The design follows the Louis XVI forms.

philosophy.core_thesis: A jewel is as light and as white as lace: platinum is so strong that the metal can almost disappear and leave only the stones.
design_principles: Make the frame in platinum, so that thin claws and fine wire hold the stones with little metal.
Draw garlands, bows, laurel wreaths, ribbons and tassels from the Louis XVI ornament.
Pierce the metal into lace and edge it with a line of tiny beads, called milgrain.
Use white stones: diamonds and pearls, with a single black pearl or sapphire as a contrast.
Cut the stones in old cuts and set them in a pattern of 3 to 5 sizes within one piece.
Build a tiara or a dog collar from many small links so that it moves like fabric.
Make a long sautoir of pearls, 120 to 150 cm, with a tassel at the end.
Keep the back of each piece open and thin, so that it stays light on the dress.
anti_patterns: Straight geometric lines and black onyx

silhouette.shape: A light, pierced jewel in white metal: a garland tiara, a dog collar of pearls, a bow brooch or a long pearl sautoir.
silhouette.line: Curved and symmetrical, in bows, swags and wreaths, with fine edges.
silhouette.fit: A dog collar sits tight at the neck, a tiara sits on the front of the hair, a bow brooch sits on the bodice.
silhouette.proportion: A dog collar is 3 to 6 cm high and as thin as a ribbon. A tiara is 5 to 8 cm high. A sautoir is 120 to 150 cm long.
rules: Fix a bow of diamonds at the centre of a pearl dog collar.
Set a tiara as a row of garlands, with a pearl drop in each loop.
Edge each platinum frame with milgrain beads.
Wear a long sautoir of pearls with a tassel of diamonds.

fabrics.rule: Use platinum for the frame and white stones for the light; keep the gold and the colour to a small accent.

methods: graduated links for a collar or a tiara
a pearl string with a diamond clasp
a bow of diamonds with a pearl drop
construction.closures: A concealed box clasp on a collar; a pin with a safety catch on a brooch; a comb or a frame on a tiara.
construction.details: Laurel leaves, bows, tassels, ribbons and swags, with a drop pearl in each loop.

surface.pattern: Garlands, ribbons and bows in lace-like open work, with tiny beads at each edge.
surface.gloss: High: white metal and diamonds at 85 to 100 GU, with a soft glow from the pearls.
surface.wear: Platinum stays white and keeps the edge; thin claws wear and need a check every few years.

palette.strategy: All white and silver: platinum, diamond and pearl, with one touch of black or a deep blue stone.

processes: pierced platinum work with an oxyhydrogen torch
making.scale: The great Paris and London houses; each piece by a team of three to ten workers for a court or a rich client.
making.signs: Milgrain edges, open and thin platinum, a symmetrical pattern and a large number of small stones.

pieces.form: Pearl dog collar with a diamond bow
Garland tiara of platinum and diamonds with pearl drops
Bow brooch of pierced platinum with milgrain edges
Diamond drop earrings with a pearl pendant
Long pearl sautoir with a diamond tassel
Diamond and platinum band with a laurel pattern

positive: pearl dog collar with a diamond bow
long pearl sautoir with a tassel

canonical_works.work: Halo tiara for the Duchess of York
Delhi Durbar necklace for Queen Mary

emotion.target_response: A cool, formal and weightless glitter: the viewer sees a court jewel that seems to float on the dress.

use_cases: costume design for an Edwardian court drama
a bridal tiara or a pearl collar
a museum label for a Cartier-era jewel
an image prompt for a white, lacy period jewel
avoid_when: the brief wants colour, bold forms or hand-made metal
the brief is a 1920s geometric piece

modifiers.how: Straighten the garlands into lines and angles, add black onyx and calibre stones, and keep the platinum and the diamonds.
Replace the platinum with silver on gold, close the settings and add foil behind each stone.

ornament_level.note: Lace work in platinum gives the ornament; a plain pearl collar sits at the low end.
